title: x402 failure: the facilitator is down or times out
summary: If verify cannot reach the facilitator, the server answers 502 and the handler does not run. If settle times out, the outcome is indeterminate and the server must reconcile on chain before it retries.

steps.label: Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
steps.detail: The client sends a valid signed payment.

steps.label: POST /verify (no answer)
steps.detail: The facilitator does not answer. The TypeScript HTTPFacilitatorClient gives up after its timeout, 90 seconds by default.

steps.label: 502 Bad Gateway
steps.detail: The @x402/express middleware turns a facilitator boundary failure into HTTP 502. The handler does not run and nothing moves on chain. The client can retry later; its signature stays valid until validBefore.

steps.label: POST /settle (times out)
steps.detail: Variant: verify worked and the handler ran, but the settle call times out. The facilitator may already have broadcast the transfer.

failures.outcome: Non-terminal. The response carries the broadcast hash; the server checks it on chain and retries at most once.

steps.label: Reconcile: look up the transaction
steps.detail: With a settlement_pending hash, or with the payer and nonce, the server checks on chain whether the transfer confirmed before it retries or refuses. Retrying blindly cannot double charge with EIP-3009 because the nonce is single use, but it can mislead the server about the outcome.
